The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.4964 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C.") seeking quash of the F.I.R. in Crime No.225 of 2020 of Kota Police Station, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.text: Kota Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.
The petitioners are A-1 to A-7 in the above crime.
A case under Sections 328, 272 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Section 51(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 was registered against them.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this is a covered matter and as per common order passed by this Court dated 05-03-2020 in Criminal Petition Nos.5103 of 2019 and batch, this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the same offences based on identical facts.

Therefore, he would submit that the petitioners herein are also similarly placed and they are also entitled for quash of the F.I.R.
5.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would also fairly concede that it is a covered matter in view of the common order dated 05-03-2020 referred above and thereby prayed to pass appropriate order accordingly.

6. As can be seen from the common order dated 05-03-2020 passed in Criminal Petition Nos.5103 of 2019 and batch, this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

7. Therefore, in view of the aforesaid common order and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the F.I.R in Crime No.225 of 2020 of Kota Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, is hereby quashed.
